title: US accuses American of allegedly wiping his phone using a duress password during border search
reason: Researched in full as the Reel B candidate and it holds up: TechCrunch and the Guardian (Timothy Pratt, 23 Jul) are genuinely independent, both reachable, both quotable. Not published for two reasons. (1) node src/state.mjs guard exited 1, BLOCKED, 0h since the Reel against a 6h minimum, so a third post tonight would have overridden the double-post control. (2) The story carries no figure: the only digits in either source are the 24 January 2025 incident date, and cbp.gov 403s from this sandbox so the device-search statistic could not be sourced. A Reel B must carry one figure. Worth picking up on merit in a later run.
